notes: Tail case: all units rewritten. U1 'railing at the left' was one of nine identical fence panels on the right -> re-masked to the whole embankment iron railing (union of all panels). U2 life jackets now a genuine structural replace. U3 'window' remove was ill-posed -> retargeted to the stack of life jackets behind the rightmost cabin window. U4 shirt was a tiny, window-occluded passenger shirt with an ambiguous ref -> retargeted to the boat's blue canvas railing cover.
